Compare Ed25519 signature algorithm against RSA-4096 in terms of key size, speed, and side-channel resistance.

Thinking Process: 1. Evaluate Curve25519 Twisted Edwards curve mathematics. 2. Ed25519 produces 64-byte signatures with 32-byte public keys. 3. RSA-4096 requires 512-byte signatures with high CPU verification overhead. 4. Detail side-channel resistance (constant-time operations in Ed25519).

Ed25519 offers superior cryptographic efficiency and security properties compared to legacy RSA-4096.

Cryptographic Benchmark Matrix

Algorithm Public Key Size Signature Size Verify Time (ms) Constant Time
Ed25519 (Curve25519) 32 bytes 64 bytes < 0.6 ms Yes (Default)
RSA-4096 512 bytes 512 bytes ~ 2.8 ms Complex padding required

Web Crypto Ed25519 Verification

export async function verifySignature(publicKey: CryptoKey, sig: Uint8Array, data: Uint8Array): Promise {
  return await crypto.subtle.verify({ name: 'Ed25519' }, publicKey, sig, data);
}
